title: Zero3 Commander terminal result
description: A genuine terminal outcome. The EXISTENCE of a result file never implies validity: it must parse, match this schema, carry the expected execution_id and task_id, set terminal true, and name a legal terminal state.

state.description: Mirrors Zero3 Pilot H5 terminal task states. outcome_unknown and blocked are honest terminal states and must never be rewritten.

error.description: Opaque failure detail relayed from Zero3, when present.

summary.description: Opaque transport-safe H5 task snapshot relayed from Zero3 Pilot. Execution authority remains on the Remote Host/Codex runtime.
